messages:
Aisha: quick sync re: operationalizing compatibility shims. we need a catalog + lifecycle not just ad-hoc gateway rules.
Jon: +1. propose a small data model: shim_id, scope (tenant/global), type(body/header/transform), expires_at, owner, cost_estimate. keep it tiny.
Priya: sounds good. how do we prevent shim sprawl? I want TTLs and an automated expiration job that emits alerts 7/3/1 days before expiry.
Miguel: agree on TTLs. also include a "compat-grade" label (gold/silver/bronze) - gold = fully tested mapping, silver = heuristic, bronze = temporary hack. console shows grade so PMs know risk.
Aisha: ops question: who pays for slower fallback paths? if a shim routes to a compatibility pool we need per-shim cost tags so billing can attribute it.
Jon: we already have per-tenant cost metrics. add `shim_tag` to billing pipeline, done.
Priya: we should standardize a header for status and one for explicit shim opt-in. example header:
```
X-Rw-Compat: id=ARCH-2026-078;scope=tenant;expires=2026-09-30
X-Rw-Compat-OptIn: ARCH-2026-078
```
Miguel: opt-in header is useful for staged rollouts. also a read-only status header: `X-Rw-Compat-Status: applied|expired|missing`. console can poll it.
Aisha: runtime enforcement: gateway only uses shims with valid TTL and owner contact. if owner unresponsive after expiry, auto-disable and open a ticket.
Jon: how to express body transforms? small DSL proposal: `path:expr -> path:expr [mode]` example: 
```
user.name -> customer.profile.displayName [copy]
items[].price_cents -> items[].price_usd [scale:0.01]
```
Priya: make DSL newline-delimited and JSON-able for storage. and require a unit test for each shim: input JSON -> expected output JSON. CI runs these.
Miguel: add a compatibility score metric (0-100) - derived from test pass rate + production diffs. surface on deprecation page.
Aisha: on the SDK side we'll add a CompatReporter: SDK emits `compat_hit` events with shim_id and dep_id. this feeds the dashboard.
Priya: recommend lint rules flagging dependency on deprecated fields at commit-time. provide autofix suggestions where mapping is straightforward.
Jon: deploy strategy: 1) create shim in catalog (owner sets TTL/grade) 2) enable in staging for N% tenants 3) monitor compat_score, latency, error delta 4) escalate or rollback.
Miguel: add an automated smoke-check that compares canonical runtime vs shimmed response for sampled requests to detect behavioral drift.
Aisha: we should gate automatic hard removals on zero active uses and compat_score > 98 for 72h. otherwise keep shims/extend TTL.
Priya: docs: each shim must include migration snippet (how to change client code) + suggested test case. link these in the changelog entry.
ops-bot: system: catalog entry created ARCH-2026-078 by Aisha at 1799998920. staging rollout enabled for 3% tenants.
Jon: action items: Aisha to prototype shim catalog API (ETA 3d), Priya to draft SDK CompatReporter + lint (ETA 1w), Miguel to spec compat_score and smoke-check (ETA 4d). I'll add billing tag support to pipeline (ETA 2d).
Aisha: documented. can we also add a simple UI to list active shims per-tenant? helps support teams.
Priya: yes. add per-tenant view + per-deprecation filter.
Miguel: final note: prefer machine ids ARCH-YYYY-NNN for traceability. keep human summary short.
Aisha: thanks everyone. we'll validate after staging run and iterate. closing thread.
